info.title: Data for Tennis canonical live stream
info.description: Limited engineering preview. ATP Tour/Challenger men singles, WTA/WTA125 singles and ITF men/women singles as observed. Predictions only for admitted ATP250/500/1000 men singles ordinary BO3 editions. Predictions remain shadow. One collector and one calculation per input revision, shared across subscribers. No commentary or proprietary model inputs are public.

live.description: Authenticate in the first message. Close1008 for invalid or expired tickets; close1013 for a slow consumer. Reconnect with a fresh ticket and last processed cursor.

Authenticate.name: Authenticate
Authenticate.title: Authenticate
Authenticate.description: First message within five seconds. Obtain a 60 second signed ticket using the REST API. Never place tickets in URLs. Renewal resets the subscription. Opt in with resumable:true for a server-issued private resume token. Reconnect with a fresh ticket, resumable:true and the previous lane token to atomically replace that lane within the two-session limit. A token grants no capabilities and is never a substitute for a valid ticket. Keep it out of logs.

Subscribe.name: Subscribe
Subscribe.title: Subscribe
Subscribe.description: Omit after for a consistent snapshot. Include it for bounded replay. Point event history is opt in; composed updates include the last point by default.

Ping.name: Ping
Ping.title: Ping
Ping.description: Application ping. Wire ping/pong heartbeats are also supported.

Authenticated.name: Authenticated
Authenticated.title: Authenticated
Authenticated.description: The ticket is verified. Resubscribe after each renewal. resume_token appears only after resumable:true. Save the latest token separately for each lane; replacement rotates it. Classic clients retain their original response shape.

Snapshot.name: Snapshot
Snapshot.title: Snapshot
Snapshot.description: Replace local state. Cursor and entity projections were selected consistently.

SnapshotStarted.name: SnapshotStarted
SnapshotStarted.title: SnapshotStarted
SnapshotStarted.description: Begin a replacement snapshot. Hold its chunks until SnapshotCompleted.

SnapshotChunk.name: SnapshotChunk
SnapshotChunk.title: SnapshotChunk
SnapshotChunk.description: Ordered bounded snapshot chunk at the shared snapshot cursor.

SnapshotCompleted.name: SnapshotCompleted
SnapshotCompleted.title: SnapshotCompleted
SnapshotCompleted.description: Commit the complete replacement snapshot. Replay catches up any events accepted while it was transmitted.

ReplayStarted.name: ReplayStarted
ReplayStarted.title: ReplayStarted
ReplayStarted.description: Following events are historical replay until ReplayCompleted.

ReplayCompleted.name: ReplayCompleted
ReplayCompleted.title: ReplayCompleted
ReplayCompleted.description: Store the checkpoint, including sequences filtered out of your subscription.

ResyncRequired.name: ResyncRequired
ResyncRequired.title: ResyncRequired
ResyncRequired.description: A replacement snapshot follows. Hot replay is bounded to 5000 events and 16 MiB; durable outbox retention is 48 hours.

Heartbeat.name: Heartbeat
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
Heartbeat.description: Shared freshness refresh without recalculating the model. Clear cached probabilities on a non-live prediction status or expiry.

MatchChanged.name: MatchChanged
MatchChanged.title: MatchChanged
MatchChanged.description: Committed event. Deduplicate by event_id and upsert entities by own ID plus revision. The composed prediction matches both score_revision and prediction_input_revision.
